methods.description: Choose a base and its perpendicular height, including an outside height or grid measurements; multiply them and halve, using square units and excluding unrelated slants.
Explain or apply two equal triangles making a parallelogram; find the parallelogram area and halve it.
Find each triangle area, using each own base and height (or the common height for parts), then compare or subtract their areas.
Find the triangle area first, then multiply by the cost per square unit.
Find the triangle area first, compare it with whole-roll coverage and buy enough whole rolls to cover the remainder.
